items.title: Bob Stewart interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: coming out from Oscar Peterson to Tatum to Ahmad Jamal. It’s got influences of a lot of that but it’s just with the tuba.

ctx.x: I have the Classic Jazz Trio except it’s been bass, drums and piano, coming out from Oscar Peterson to Tatum to Ahmad Jamal. It’s got influences of a lot of that but it’s just with the tuba. Billy Hart’s playing drums. We did a gig recently and we got reviews from the Times and the Voice and everything, it was really fantastic. And we’re going to be doing something else up at Columbia come, if you’re available come on into the city, please. The 31st is going to be a party. Columbia has this annual Halloween…
